reuse.why: Changes the existing exported getScheduledAmount helper and routes the one remaining inline copy (schedule-template.ts) through it.

duplication.why: Removes the last inline midpoint computation, so the ranged-amount rule now exists only in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the shared module every server and client schedule consumer already imports it from.

scope.why: Touches only the helper, the one bypassing call site and tests for the helper.

maintainability.why: A single small function now defines the expected amount for all consumers; only a stale 'average' comment in Balance.tsx is left behind.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts, which previously bypassed getScheduledAmount, now calls it.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the duplicate in schedule-template.ts is removed rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template, forecast, schedules app, SchedulesTable and Balance.
